UnitStatement: The document defines harness validation traceability for the frontend harness.
Requirement mapping for deliverable DEL-07-01 links each requirement to its coverage artifact(s).

REQ-01 Validation Script Coverage is covered by the validate-harness-section8.mjs required check set: setup.server_reachable, regression.session_crud, section8.boot_error_taxonomy, section8.smoke_stream, section8.session_persistence_resume, section8.permissions_dontask, section8.interrupt_sigint, section8.sdk_native_stream.
REQ-02 Local Execution is covered by running `npm run harness:validate:section8` from the frontend/ directory.
REQ-03 CI-Ready Posture is covered by `npm run harness:validate:premerge`, which is non-interactive and exit-code based.
REQ-04 Session Boot Validation is covered by the section8.boot_error_taxonomy check plus the routes.test.ts boot route tests.
REQ-05 Turn Execution Validation is covered by section8.smoke_stream, section8.session_persistence_resume, plus route tests for invalid empty turns.
REQ-06 SSE Streaming Validation is covered by the section8.smoke_stream and section8.sdk_native_stream checks.
REQ-07 Opts Mapping/Fallback is covered by the harness-options.test.ts unit tests.
REQ-08 Subagent Governance Fail-Closed is covered by section8.permissions_dontask, harness-subagent-governance.test.ts, and governance route tests.
REQ-09 Attachment Resolver Validation is covered by harness-attachment-resolver.test.ts and attachment-focused route tests.
REQ-10 Prompt Mode Selection Validation is covered by prompt-mode assertions in routes.test.ts.
REQ-11 Validation Documentation is covered by frontend/docs/harness/README.md and this traceability file.
REQ-12 Repeatable Execution is covered by two consecutive harness:validate:premerge runs and a deterministic summary schema.
REQ-13 CONTRACT K-Invariant Coverage is covered by governance, options, and route tests (harness-subagent-governance.test.ts, harness-options.test.ts, routes.test.ts).
REQ-14 Test Isolation is covered because Vitest unit tests are independently executable and section8 checks are isolated by per-check setup/cleanup.
REQ-15 Error Path Validation is covered by section8.boot_error_taxonomy and route tests for invalid request, attachment, and governance paths.
REQ-16 Deliverable Acceptance Criteria is covered by the harness:validate:premerge gate plus docs and the traceability mapping.
The premerge script enforces required check IDs and fails if legacy IDs appear.
The validation suite uses stable machine-readable summary output for CI consumption.
